description: This file implements a singly linked list data structure with typical list operations such as add, remove, size, and get by index.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A Kotlin class representing a singly linked list with methods to add, remove, retrieve size, and access elements by index.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the data at the specified index.
